gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-cypro-: Cut-back terminals leave Noto Sans Cypro Minoan reading light and spacious. Over a full page that spacing keeps the sans easy on the eye, while Pixelify Sans holds its heading line steady and bold.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-hanifi: Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya shows a visibly gaping c at any size, beneath Pixelify Sans and its fixed-pressure stylus line. Page after page it stays approachable and modern, never tiring.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Pixelify Sans draws every curve without any thinning, which gives its display lines a bold, expressive punch. But Noto Sans Hatran does the quieter job, with a wide funnel-like throat in the e.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: A single-width stroke runs through every glyph of Pixelify Sans, giving it a bold, expressive display voice. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps every small counter unclogged, with a contemporary, approachable feel.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-javane: Connected counters define Noto Sans Javanese, with apertures open to the outside space. Pixelify Sans, drawn like a neon sign tube of single width, makes a bold heading, so use it larger than the sans below.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Clean describes Noto Sans Kawi, whose open-jawed c looks like a pair of pliers. And over a full page this plain sans reads neutral, while Pixelify Sans turns corners without a pressure swell.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-linear: Full-width stroke joins, never thin hairlines, mark Pixelify Sans and give the heading its bold look. Noto Sans Linear A sits below as a clean plain sans, its gaping c giving that bold heading space to breathe.
Smooth paths around every bend mark Noto Sans Linear B. Pixelify Sans, with no visible difference between up and side strokes, would lose its bold presence if made small, so give it size.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-manich: Modern is the mood of Noto Sans Manichaean, whose e crossbars have open mouths, sitting under the monoweight skeleton of Pixelify Sans. Across a full page it stays clean and unfussy.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-noto-sans-mongol: Flared terminals give Noto Sans Mongolian a smooth, modern read as sans-serif text. But Pixelify Sans is the one for display, a monoline stroke from start to finish that carries bold, expressive headings.
